==Part 5: Combat, Thieving & Advanced Skilling==
{{Checklist| * Run east to bank, deposit herblore supplies (keep offensive mage spells, keep bronze, steel, mith, addy, rune pickaxe) * Withdraw [[Big fishing net]] * Run to pub, buy 5 [[Jug of wine]] * League menu tele to Varlamore * Run west to blacksmith, buy [[Adamant platebody|addy platebody]]/[[Adamant platelegs|legs]], [[Bronze platebody|bronze platebody]]/[[Bronze platelegs|legs]], [[Mithril spear]], [[Steel platebody]], [[Iron dagger]] * Equip steel platebody, full bronze, iron dagger, mith spear. * Low alch steel platebody * Run south to bank, deposit addy, bronze, iron dagger. Withdraw 15 [[Pineapple]]s, [[Bucket]], Chaos runes (Wind Bolt is fine), big net (fill rest of inventory with jugs of wine, may only be ~3). Equip mith spear and keep it with you. * Run northwest to nearby dungeon icon, go downstairs and kill [[Guard]] * Go upstairs, run to western Civitas wall, then north to other dungeon icon * Go down ladder, run northwest, up ladder * Kill [[Thief (Varlamore)|Thief]] * Run south, milk buffalo * Run south, kill buffalo * Go into house east of allotments, churn butter * Pick up [[Potato]] to the southwest, bake in previous house, add butter * Put 15 pineapples in [[Compost Bin]], close lid * Pickpocket [[Farmer]] until 3 [[Potato seed]]s * Buy [[Rake]] from Harminia * Rake allotment patch, plant potatoes, buy 2 compost from farmer, protect potato patch with Harminia * Run west, safespot [[Dire wolf]] over plants * Run southwest, kill [[Scorpion]] with mith spear * Mine 6+ [[Tin ore]], 1+ [[Copper ore]] (stay until 15 mining) * Run southeast to [[Jaguar]]s (east of Sunset coast), defeat without taking damage * Run southeast, kill a [[Hill Giant]] (Demonic pact point) * Run far east to [[Stonecutter Outpost]] * Mine 1 [[Clay]], 50 [[Iron ore]], 20 [[Silver ore]], 2 [[Coal]], 3 [[Gold ore]], 50 [[Mithril ore]]. Mine extra iron to get to level 55 for mithril * Run east to coast, big net fish for 20 [[Raw mackerel|Mackerel]], 10 [[Raw cod|Cod]] * Run northwest to [[Oryx]] (northwest of hunter icon). Kill with melee (entire kill needs to be with melee) * Run north to Civitas crafting shop, buy [[Tiara mould]], [[Ring mould]], [[Amulet mould]]. * Go upstairs, check for [[Soft clay]] (1 min respawn on table). Take if there, otherwise can take bucket of water and withdraw clay from bank. * Go downstairs, make anything on potters wheel, then fire at pottery oven * Withdraw 150 arrow shafts, 150 feathers. make 150 [[Headless arrow]]s (unless you made earlier) * Make at the furnace to the north: 1 [[Bronze bar]], 10 [[Iron bar]]s * Run South to anvil, smith 150 [[Iron arrowtips]] * Run back to furnace, make 150 [[Iron arrow]]s on the way * Smelt 20 [[Silver bar]]s, make 20 [[Silver tiara]]s * Deposit all, withdraw coins, [[Dramen staff]], jugs of wine. Buy extra wine at bar for thieving training * Pickpocket Farmer south of varlamore to 36 [[Thieving]] * Run southwest to fairy ring, tele to [[Zanaris]] * Buy [[Slayer's staff]] (for Death's coffers task), [[Anti-dragon shield]]. Wear shield. * Enter [[Puro-Puro]] in wheat field (skip if you didn't get 17+ hunter earlier, come back whenever you feel like, it's not a quick task if you're not woodsman) * Claim [[Butterfly net]] from [[Elnock Inquisitor]] (can drop jugs of wine) * Catch 50 implings in puro puro (spawn camp 1 baby or young impling spawn) * Teleport to [[Aldarin]] (CKQ) * Run to [[Ruby harvest]]s to the west, catch 1 * Go upstairs in house northeast of ruby harvests * Lockpick [[Chest (Aldarin Villas)|chests]] until 2 [[Gold bar]]s and 40+ [[Thieving]]. Run southwest to house if teleported outside. Keep uncut diamonds, gold bars, blessed bone shards, desirable seeds. Can drop anything else. * After 40 thieving/2 gold bars, league menu tele to Varlamore * Run southeast to bank, withdraw amulet mould, ring mould, cut sapphire, cut emerald. * Make [[Sapphire amulet]], [[Emerald ring]] at furnace * Pickpocket Guards until 28 [[Coin pouch]]es (don't open until you get all) * Open 28 coin pouches at once * Run to southern varlamore gate * Pickpocket [[Master farmer]] south of Varlamore * Run east, defeat 3 [[Chicken]]s in 6 seconds (melee). Don't miss ticks. You can mage the 3rd for a better chance at a high hit if you're low str. You can cheese this by getting several to low hp and running away, then engaging when all 3 are prepped. }}
If you have the first magic pact, you can boost your level for the following 2 tasks by casting combat spells on any npcs. {{Colour|Red|If you weren't planning on going magic early, DO NOT TAKE THIS PACT JUST FOR THIS PERK.}} You only get 3 pact tree resets and you need to kill your first Echo boss to earn your first reset. Be smart about what you choose.
{{Checklist| * Run to bank, withdraw death rune, cast [[Earth Blast]] if 53 magic * Cast [[Civitas illa Fortis Teleport]] if 54 magic }}
